scenes.notes: Intimate silhouettes emerge through twilight rain glass.

scenes.name: 09 · City in Rearview (Bar 17)
scenes.notes: City in the rearview fading to black.

scenes.name: 18 · Synth Rail Flight (Bar 39)
scenes.notes: Through the cold and the rain, through promises made.

scenes.name: 19 · Piston Climax (Bar 43)
scenes.notes: Maximum 18-shell woofer excursion with 3D key-light lift.

scenes.name: 20 · Post-Chorus Breath (Bar 47)
scenes.notes: Breath pause as beat strips back: It’s the fire we keep.

scenes.name: 21 · Verse 2: Neon Haze (Bar 49)
scenes.notes: Years come and go like a neon haze.

scenes.name: 22 · Vacuum Tube Warmth (Bar 51)
scenes.notes: People get lost in the crowded days. Warm thermionic glow.

scenes.name: 23 · Hands on the Wheel (Bar 53)
scenes.notes: I got your handwriting locked in my mind.

scenes.notes: Hands on the wheel and the engine hums.

scenes.notes: Waiting for the moment that the feeling comes.

scenes.name: 26 · Polar Scope Resonance (Bar 59)
scenes.notes: Polar mandala ripples with percussion formants.

scenes.name: 27 · Can You Feel the Rise (Bar 61)
scenes.notes: Can you feel the pulse? Can you feel the rise?

scenes.name: 28 · Neon Arp Surge (Bar 63)
scenes.notes: Cutting through the noise behind my eyes.

scenes.name: 29 · Transducer Excursion (Bar 65)
scenes.notes: I hear you breathing in the dark.

scenes.name: 30 · Lissajous Twisting Chamber (Bar 67)
scenes.notes: Every heartbeat leaves a mark.

scenes.name: 31 · Climax Threshold (Bar 69)
scenes.notes: Final bar before the monumental climax drop.

scenes.name: 32 · Climax Hook: The Fire We Keep (Bar 71)
scenes.notes: Monumental climax drop. It’s the fire we keep!

scenes.name: 33 · Instrumental Arp Expressway (Bar 75)
scenes.notes: Full-throttle melodic house synth arpeggios on wet night highway.

scenes.name: 34 · Grand Subwoofer Flex (Bar 79)
scenes.notes: Maximum excursion with recessed surround depth.

scenes.name: 35 · 32-Band VFD Spectrum (Bar 83)
scenes.notes: Full color organ illuminated in cyan, magenta, and amber.

scenes.notes: Pull me in... where you end and where I begin.

scenes.notes: Still burning. The fire we keep. Slow fade to black.

theme: Late-night psychological drive at 2:00 AM in a 1970s sports coupe through cold city rain, holding onto love and purpose through exhaustion. Fine-art charcoal and graphite paper sketch illuminated by glowing electric cyan, magenta, and amber neon currents.
